_meta.purpose: Look settings for the Quick Quiz swatch cards (docs/SWATCH_ROOMS_PLAN.md).
_meta.strip: The colour of the strip holding the question: 'yellow' (the brand yellow with dark text) or 'navy' (the brand navy with off-white text, Jaida 2026-11-22). Switch here to compare; save and refresh the page.
_meta.embedMinHeight: Inside the website's iframe only (/embed-test), the quiz is at least this tall, in pixels: 'phone' below 640px wide, 'computer' from 640px wide. Shorter cards leave space above the buttons instead of shrinking the iframe (Jaida, 2026-11-22). Set to null to let the iframe fit each card again. Starting values estimated from the tallest card; tune by eye.
